segments.name: Pet products
segments.description: Designs and manufactures pet leashes, collars, harnesses and intelligent pet products, mostly sold to pet stores in the U.S. and Europe.
segments.evidence: The Company determined it operates as one consolidated segment and therefore has one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Pet stores and other customers pay the company for leashes, collars, harnesses, intelligent pet products and dyeing services.
revenueModel.evidence: Most products are exported to the U.S. and Europe and sold to pet stores, including major pet store chains.
